description_en: Creates a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) CPE or vCPE instance
description_zh: 创建智能接入网关实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-smart-access-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 12 --auto-pay false --hard-ware-spec sag-100wm --receiver-country China --receiver-state Zhejiang --receiver-city Hangzhou --receiver-district West_Lake --receiver-town Zhuantang --receiver-zip 310000 --receiver-mobile 18840850000 --receiver-name John_Doe --receiver-email xx@example.com --buyer-message Message --receiver-address No._XX --ha-type no_backup --charge-type PREPAY --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmartAccessGateway

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where you want to deploy the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the SAG instance.

If you want to create an SAG CPE instance and the model is sag-100wm, valid values of this parameter are 2 to 50. Unit: Mbit/s.
If you want to create an SAG CPE instance and the model is sag-1000, valid values of this parameter are 10 to 500. Unit: Mbit/s.
If you want to create an SAG vCPE instance, valid values of this parameter are 10 to 1000. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例的带宽。 

如果要创建智能接入网关硬件版实例，且智能接入网关设备规格为sag-100wm，带宽取值范围为2~50 Mbps。
如果要创建智能接入网关硬件版实例，且智能接入网关设备规格为sag-1000，带宽取值范围为10~500 Mbps。
如果要创建智能接入网关vCPE版实例，带宽取值范围为10~1000 Mbps。
parameters.name: max_band_width

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SAG instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the SAG instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例的描述信息。

描述长度为2~256个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the SAG instance. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例的购买时长，单位：月。

取值：1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment for the instance. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no

If you set the parameter to false, go to Billing Management to complete the payment after you call this operation. After you complete the payment, the instance can be created
parameters.help_zh:

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

如果您选择不自动支付账单，在您调用本接口后，请前往控制台的订单中心完成支付，实例才能创建成功
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode. Valid values:

no_backup: You buy only one SAG device to connect private networks to Alibaba Cloud.
cold_backup: You buy two SAG devices in active-standby mode. One SAG device serves as an active device and the other serves as a standby device. Only the active device is connected to Alibaba Cloud. If the active device is not working as expected, you must manually perform a switchover.
warm_backup: You buy two SAG devices in active-active mode. Both SAG devices are connected to Alibaba Cloud. If an active device is not working as expected, a failover is automatically performed.

If you want to create an SAG vCPE instance, set the value to warm_backup
parameters.help_zh:
选择一种使用方式。取值： 

no_backup：只购买一台智能接入网关设备接入阿里云。  
cold_backup：购买两台智能接入网关设备共享带宽，仅主设备在线。当主设备发生故障时，需手动切换至备设备。
warm_backup：购买两台智能接入网关设备共享带宽，两台设备同时在线。当主设备故障时自动切换到备设备。 

在您创建智能接入网关vCPE实例时，本参数仅取值warm_backup
parameters.name: ha_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the SAG instance.

Set the value to PREPAY, which specifies the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: already_have_sag
